title: The Return Of Grace (reopened)
description:
If you have
been waiting, hoping, or if something in your heart has been quietly longing
for His darshan — this may be your moment. Due to the
present uncertainties across the world, a few devotees who had earlier
registered for“The Return of Grace”event are unable to travel. As a result, alimited
number of seats have become available once again.

title: Blossom - A Season of Inner Bloom (Open Event)
description:
There are moments in life when the soul does not seek
answers - it simply seeks presence. The presence of something greater,
something eternal, something that needs no words to be felt.
